name: HivePunk 632
subject: Pixel Art Atlas (Angais/pixel-art-atlas-1.4m)
thesis: Pixel Art Atlas is a large, conveniently split synthetic sprite dataset whose main value is scale and permissive intent, but whose caption reliability and third-party rights are explicitly unverified. It should be treated as raw material requiring inspection, not as a curated asset library.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: thantaigocua1515-cmd/pixel-art-api has 50 raw commits in the last 30 days, 46 of them real work (not docs, formatting, bots, templates or trivial).

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Its latest real commit is bfd0ffa, on 2026-11-11.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Pixel Art Atlas contains 1,409,404 synthetic game sprites with English captions, covering 6,194 training subjects.
claims.quote: 1,409,404 synthetic game sprites with English captions, covering 6,194 training subjects.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Each sprite is a native 16x16 image with a transparent background.
claims.quote: Each sprite is a native 16×16 image with a transparent background.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: The images were generated from text prompts with Krea 2 Turbo and a pixel art LoRA.
claims.quote: The images were generated from text prompts with Krea 2 Turbo and a pixel art LoRA.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: The dataset has a train split of 1.41M rows and a validation split of 4.1k rows.
claims.quote: Split (2) train · 1.41M rows train (1.41M rows) validation (4.1k rows)

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: The dataset repository includes pixel-art-16x16-1.4m.zip at 259 MB.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Captions generally describe what the generator was asked to draw.
claims.quote: Caption quality: Captions generally describe what the generator was asked to draw.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Image-caption agreement has not been systematically reviewed.
claims.quote: Image–caption agreement has not been systematically reviewed.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: The related API states the dataset was released by its author under CC0 1.0.
claims.quote: Data source: Angais/pixel-art-atlas-1.4m on Hugging Face — AI-generated sprites (Krea 2 Turbo + pixel-art LoRA) released by the dataset author under CC0 1.0 .

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Captions are approximate and the release does not grant rights in third-party material or trademarks.
claims.quote: Captions are approximate; the release does not grant rights in third-party material or trademarks.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: The related pixel-art-api repository has 489 commits.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: thantaigocua1515-cmd/pixel-art-api has 50 raw commits in the last 30 days, 46 of them real work.

claims.label: DERIVED
claims.text: The dataset averages about 227.5 sprites per training subject.

risks: Captions generally describe what the generator was asked to draw, not verified content.
Image-caption agreement has not been systematically reviewed, so mismatches may be common.
Captions are approximate and the release does not grant rights in third-party material or trademarks.
Synthetic generation may reproduce styles, characters or trademark-like elements the CC0 release does not clear.
The 259 MB zip and 1.41M-row scale make inspection and filtering non-trivial for casual users.
wouldChangeMind: A systematic image-caption audit with an error rate
The full LICENSE text and provenance of the pixel-art LoRA training data
Download, like and downstream reuse figures showing verified adoption
